title: Sand Flea Jumping Robot
summary: A short Boston Dynamics clip of the Sand Flea, an 11-pound RC-car-style robot that can jump about 30 feet into the air. An onboard stabilization system keeps it oriented in flight and for landings.
why: Brought up as a favorite and as an inspiration for small, cheap jumping robots for obstacle crossing and planetary exploration.

quote.text: My favorite is the Sand Flea, a small car which can jump 9 meters (30-feet) into the air
